name: v1.10.0
body:
## What's Changed
* exclude linking to lib rt for QNX to avoid linking error by @Osama131 in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2114
* fix(pyproject): Update license to SPDX identifier by @nicholasjng in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2120
* Replicate generic hardware events on all CPU PMUs by @pcc in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2123
* #2125: Fix error: format string is not a string literal (#2126) by @sergio-nsk in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2126
* Revert "Remove redundant feature checks on re-run of CMake config ste… by @dsharlet in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2127
* Bump the version of python used for pip. by @dmah42 in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2130
* Add BENCHMARK_NAMED macro for named benchmarks without lambda by @5kng in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2135
* cmake: cache HAVE_* results to skip feature checks on re-runs by @5kng in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2137
* multiple fixes to avoid Windows x64 crashes by @dmah42 in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2139
* Refactor/modularize headers by @dmah42 in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2140
* refactor ToExponentAndMantissa to use StrFormat instead of std::stringstream by @dmah42 in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2138
* Fix CMake detection on pthread_affinity test on FreeBSD by @aokblast in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2146
* Add WASI compatibility by @ashvardanian in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2144
* docs: document benchmark_min_time CLI forms by @felmonon in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2154
* feat: Add ScopedPauseTiming RAII helper by @dmah42 in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2157
* Fix two GCC 16 issues by @gruenich in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2164
* [doc] Properly document CMake minimum required version as 3.13 by @gruenich in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2162
* In PerfCountersTest.MultiThreaded, serialize worker threads by @musicinmybrain in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2175
* Fix thread safety attribute detection failing to link in CMake check by @anishesg in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2178
* Replace deprecated _ReadWriteBarrier with std::atomic_signal_fence in MSVC path by @qorexdevs in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2177
* docs: document benchmark argument names by @shreejaykurhade in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2180
* Docs: JSON output format by @shreejaykurhade in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2181
* BENCHMARK_ENABLE_WERROR=Off should also disable -pedantic-errors by @ednolan in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2183
* docs: Add comprehensive command-line options documentation by @jlaportebot in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2187
* Fix .gitignore to unignore .cmake files recursively under cmake/ by @ShawayL in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2191
* Sort entry in AUTHORS and CONTRIBUTORS by @ShawayL in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2192
* Add -lpfm to pkg-config Libs.private when libpfm is enabled by @kiwigitops in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2194
* Fix pkg-config paths for absolute install dirs by @Haihan-Jiang in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2198
* Add AGENTS.md by @LebedevRI in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2202
* Clarify benchmark_main CMake target usage by @Haihan-Jiang in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2205
* Document static library benchmark registration by @Haihan-Jiang in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2200
* Document CMake embedding guidance by @Haihan-Jiang in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2203
* Skip errored runs when computing repetition statistics by @Haihan-Jiang in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2199
* Clarify DoNotOptimize const-ref warning by @Haihan-Jiang in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2201
* Skip perf counter tests when counters are unavailable by @Haihan-Jiang in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2204
* Tune AGENTS.md by @LebedevRI in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2208
* CONTRIBUTING: actually link to AGENTS.md by @LebedevRI in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2211
* Disable allocation zeroing in benchmarks on Android by @charlesmunger in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2214
* Handle missing locale in test on more platforms by @alyssais in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2219
* Fix up windows tests by @dmah42 in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2220
* Introduce Rust bindings by @dmah42 in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2221
* better rust build/test by @dmah42 in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2223
* rust bindings: keep argv[0] alive across benchmark reporting by @Alearner12 in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2237
* docs: document Bazel integration by @tuna4ll in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2238
* Run an autofix pass on github workflows using zizmor by @dmah42 in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2233
* fix(linux): prevent infinite re-exec loop under AppArmor by @anishesg in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2239
* Make --benchmark_list_tests respect --benchmark_format by @devtejasx in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2245
* Fix typos, add codespell configuration by @mwtoews in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2262
* Fix compile error with clang -Werror -Wunused-template by @aokblast in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2268
* Fix use-after-free in CreateDefaultDisplayReporter (#2240) by @devtejasx in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2265
* Exclude setup/teardown from the MemoryManager measurement window (#2149) by @devtejasx in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2276
* Make random number generator thread-local in perf_counters_gtest. by @oontvoo in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2283
* Update Bazel tooling for Python bindings by @stanbot8 in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2287
* Fix tsan/asan/hwasan/etc failures on Android by @charlesmunger in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2229
* Ignore skipped benchmark when computing geomean by @Krzmbrzl in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2290
* Py tooling: fix Windows terminal color output and handle color flags in compare.py (fixes #642) by @jdymitarai in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2297
* Report the complexity aggregates in the family's time unit by @lenamonj in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2294
* Replace offsetof cache-line check with a well-defined runtime check (#1877) by @devtejasx in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2264
* Detect thread safety attribute support in mutex.h (#2263) by @devtejasx in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2275
* Diagnose invalid PauseTiming()/ResumeTiming() calls (#2235) by @devtejasx in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2274
* Register Python 3.14 with Bazel by @stanbot8 in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2307
* feat: allow custom multiplier in Benchmark::ThreadRange (fixes #1531) by @ReturnKartikey in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2304
* Pass State to ProfilerManager via new WithState hooks (#2234) by @Chaturvediharsh123 in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2313
* feat(reporter): introduce scientific notation for counters in console (fixes #818) by @ReturnKartikey in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2305
* fix(timing): Do not resume timing in pause scope on skipped benchmarks by @nicholasjng in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2318
* Guard result.rms against division by zero by @stanbot8 in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2317
* Add Python 3.13–3.15 and free-threading wheel support by @hawkinsp in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2314
* Apply UseManualTime to BM_bytes_per_second and BM_items_per_second by @stanbot8 in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2320
* Add `State::in_timed_section()` helper by @nicholasjng in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2319
* fix(mutex): hold lock during notify_all in Barrier::wait to prevent teardown race (fixes #1672) by @jdymitarai in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2325
* Support DoNotOptimize on types with const members (#1997) by @devtejasx in https://github.com/google/benchmark/pull/2291
